name: oh-my-fable
description: Anthropic's prompting-guide rules for Claude Code, always on (Opus 5.5, Fable 5.2, Fable 5.1; Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 too): install and forget: the working rules load at every session start and reach subagents, unattended sessions are detected automatically and get the early-stop and ordinary-obstacle rules, sessions at xhigh or max effort get the stop-after-checks rule, /fable turns a rough request into a guide-aligned prompt, /fable-status shows what is in effect, /fable-audit finds which guide sections your own rules are missing, /fable-setup moves the rules into a rules file (recommended once).

card.title: Improved request card
card.description: Draw the improved request that /fable prints as a card in the transcript (terminal Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, and the desktop app). Turn off to keep the plain code block.

status_line.title: Status line at session start
status_line.description: Show the one-line oh-my-fable status when a new session starts. Turn off to see only the welcome line, the line after an update, and notices that need your attention.
